name: Kenites The
overview: The Kenites are closely connected with the Midianites, as seen in the example of Jethro, the priest of Midian and Moses' father-in-law, who joined Israel in the wilderness with his family (Exodus 18:1-6). This relationship highlights their integration with Israel during the Exodus period. The Kenites dwelt among Israel and were known for their kindness to the people, demonstrating a unique bond amid the broader context of surrounding nations.
